description: AN Textile Mills Limited is a spinning company established in 1982, operating a spinning unit at 35 km on the Sheikhupura Road, Tehsil Jaranwala, in Faisalabad district. It produces polyester-cotton and cotton yarn in the blends required by national and international markets, and has added spindles to lift output from about 450 to 650 bags of yarn a day.
headOffice: 35 km, Sheikhupura Road, Tehsil Jaranwala, District Faisalabad, Pakistan
sourceNote: Written from: antextile.com.pk — home page, company profile, contact us and board of directors pages (accessed 2026-10-17)
